div.head: I Atr 1.9
div.ab: ⁊ gif seo lad forðcume, beo he þæs weres wurðe.
⁊ gyf seo lad forðcume, beo he ðes weres wyrðe.
Et si lada procedat, sit were sue dignus.
⁊ gyf seo lad forðcume, beo he ðes weres wyrðe.
Und wenn diese Reinigung zu Stande kommt, so sei er zu jenem Wergeld [seines verklagten Untergebenen] berechtigt.
And if this clearing succeeds, let him be entitled to that wergild [of his accused dependant].
And if he succeeds in clearing himself, he shall be entitled to the wergeld.
